title: 第八十四章 筷子杀人第八十三章 兑换暴龙兽
slug: 火影之银色王座第九十四章恶魔
content_zh:
卡卡西没有回答铁血凯的话，而是看向了铁血凯，问道“阿凯，你的父亲，怎么死的，你知道吗？”
闻言，一向青春，老顽童的铁血凯傻住了。阿斯玛等人正要说话的时候，卡卡西继续问道“阿斯玛！你大哥，又是怎么死的呢？”
怎么死的？
阿斯玛一听，眉头也是不由的皱了起来！卡卡西的话，让他们也是不由的回想起来了往事！
“难道说......”铁血凯难以置信的望着卡卡西，阿斯玛等人也是愣在了原地！
他们都已经想到了一个答案！让他们难以置信的答案。卡卡西注意到他们的表情，便是呵呵道“看来你们也想到了是吧！阿凯，拿你的父亲来说吧！他是比你更会运用八门遁甲的忍者！而长老团在你父亲死后给你的报告答案是，执行任务回来的路上被不明忍者进攻，最后战死！”
卡卡西又是道“铁血凯，记得那时候我和你一起去看过，那时候你父亲的伤势是腋下！你该知道，你父亲的**已经达到了百炼金刚的程度，唯一罩门便是腋下！那么敌人怎么会知道？”
卡卡西毫不隐瞒的说了出来！
铁血凯沉默了。卡卡西抬头望着天空“我的父亲，我的老师，他们是我的亲人！波风冥帝，就像是我的弟弟一样，他是我剩下唯一的亲人了，如果他要走，我一定和他一起离开。”
铁血凯拳头紧握，已经渐渐的有了自己的打算！他平时看上去，是没脑子的家伙！
但未必真的没脑子！
而此刻阿斯玛等忍者却一脸难以抉择！毕竟他们和木叶没有仇怨什么的！
他们还要再仔细好好想一想该怎么抉择才可以！
此时的卡卡西和铁血凯，这斗了那么多年的兄弟，同时看了看对方，便是离去！
终于，在这一天的傍晚！
火影的暗部给木叶忍者们送上了一封请柬！这是大名晚宴的请柬！
“真的要去吗？老哥？”鸣人看着手中拿着请柬的波风冥帝，担忧的问道。
就算鸣人那么粗神经的人，都知道，这一次没准是鸿门宴！波风冥帝一进去，要是答应成为大名守护忍十二士，那还好！
冥帝不答应，毫无疑问，大名将会在宴会上格杀波风冥帝！
“去！”波风冥帝豪爽的笑了起来“好戏终于要上演了！我们怎么可以不去呢？”

夜！
月凉如水。
波风冥帝带着鸣人，佐助已经来到了宴会之上！知道等下肯定有一战的鸣人，赶忙找东西吃了起来，就是佐助也是到了一旁休息，养精蓄锐！
而二楼之上的大名，王妃一直都是观察着来人！当着王妃注意到了波风冥帝的时候，美眸顿时一亮，看起来挺结实的少年！
“爱妃，你说那银发少年，应该就是波风冥帝了吧？”大名问道。王妃轻轻的点了点头“我也这么觉得！”
“我一定会让他为我所用的。”大名呵呵笑道“当然，我必须先修正，修正他的傲气。”
大名的话一说完，一楼的大厅之中便是出现了十二个少年！他们腰上有着“火”字腰布。
“波风冥帝？”
“他就是大名说的波风冥帝，大名可是叫我们来灭一灭他的锐气！”
content_en:
Kakashi did not answer Tetsue Kai's words, but looked at Tetsue Kai and asked, "Kai, do you know how your father died?"
Hearing this, the always youthful and old naughty Iron-Blooded Kai was stunned. When Asuma and the others were about to speak, Kakashi continued to ask, "Asuma! How did your elder brother die?"
How did you die?
Asuma couldn't help but frown when he heard this! Kakashi's words made them couldn't help but recall the past!
"Could it be that..." Tetsukai looked at Kakashi in disbelief, and Asuma and others were also stunned!
They all already thought of an answer! An answer that left them in disbelief. Kakashi noticed their expressions and chuckled, "It seems you have thought of it too, right! Kai, take your father for example! He is a ninja who is better at using the Eight Gate Armor than you! And the answer to the report given to you by the elders after your father's death was that he was attacked by unknown ninjas on the way back from the mission, and finally died in battle!"
Kakashi said again, "Tetsukai, I remember that I went to see your father with you at that time. At that time, your father's injury was under the armpit! You should know that your father's body has reached the level of the Hundred Alchemy King Kong. The only thing that can cover the door is the armpit! So how would the enemy know?"
Kakashi said it without any secret!
Tie Xue Kai was silent. Kakashi looked up at the sky, "My father, my teacher, they are my relatives! Namikaze Hades is like my younger brother. He is my only remaining relative. If he wants to leave, I will leave with him."
Tie Xue Kai clenched his fists and gradually had his own plan! He usually seems to be a brainless guy!
But it may not really be brainless!
But at this moment, Asuma and the other ninjas looked like they couldn't make a choice! After all, they have no grudge against Konoha or anything!
They need to think carefully about how to make a decision!
At this time, Kakashi and Tetsue Kai, brothers who had been fighting for so many years, looked at each other at the same time and left!
Finally, in the evening of this day!
The ANBU of the Hokage sent an invitation to the Konoha ninjas! This is the invitation to the daimyo’s dinner party!
"Are you really going, brother?" Naruto looked at Namikaze Hades holding the invitation in his hand and asked worriedly.
Even someone as crude as Naruto knew that this time it might be the Hongmen Banquet! As soon as Namikaze Hade enters, if he agrees to become the twelve guardian ninjas of the daimyo, that would be fine!
If Emperor Hades refuses to agree, there is no doubt that the daimyo will kill Emperor Hades Namikaze at the banquet!
"Go!" Namikaze Hades laughed boldly, "The show is finally about to begin! How can we not go?"
Night!
The moon is as cold as water.
Namikaze Hades brought Naruto and Sasuke to the banquet! Knowing that there would be a battle later, Naruto hurriedly found something to eat. Even Sasuke also went to the side to rest and recharge his batteries!
As for the daimyo on the second floor, the princess is always observing the coming people! When the princess noticed Namikaze Hades, her beautiful eyes suddenly lit up. He looked like a very strong young man!
"My beloved, do you think that silver-haired boy is Namikaze Hades?" the daimyo asked. The princess nodded gently, "I think so too!"
"I will definitely let him use it for me." The daimyo chuckled, "Of course, I must correct his arrogance first."
As soon as the daimyo finished speaking, twelve teenagers appeared in the hall on the first floor! They have loincloths with the word "fire" on their waists.
"Namikaze Underworld Emperor?"
"He is the Namikaze Hades the Daimyo said. The Daimyo asked us to destroy his spirit!"
